user.title: Enable Banking
user.description:
Enter your Enable Banking application details. The private key must be a file inside /config (never paste it here). The redirect URL must be EXACTLY one of those registered for your application.

Currently registered URLs: {registered}

authorize.title: Authorise access at your bank
authorize.description: Your bank's page opens in another window. Complete the login there and come back: the setup continues by itself.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew authorisation
reauth_confirm.description: The authorisation with the bank has expired. Press Submit to authorise access again.

error.key_not_found: The private key file was not found at that path.
error.key_path_not_allowed: The key must be inside /config (and NEVER in /config/www, which is public).
error.invalid_key: The file is not a valid RSA private key (it should start with -----BEGIN).
error.invalid_auth: Enable Banking rejected the application ID or key.
error.redirect_bad_path: The redirect URL must end with /enablebanking/callback.
error.redirect_not_registered: That URL is not registered for your Enable Banking application. Registered: {registered}
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This bank is already configured with that application.
abort.no_accounts: The bank did not share any account.
abort.key_not_found: The private key file was not found.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Pulls fresh data from every connected bank right now, instead of waiting for the next scheduled sync.

force.name: Force
force.description: Sync even if the daily limit or a bank-imposed pause would normally block it. Use sparingly: this spends part of the limited number of automatic checks banks allow per day.

get_transactions.name: Get transactions
get_transactions.description: Reads transactions from the local database (never contacts the bank). Combines every connected bank unless Account (IBAN) is set.

account_iban.name: Account (IBAN)
account_iban.description: Limit to one account. If omitted, applies across every connected bank.

date_from.name: From date
date_from.description: Only transactions on or after this date.

date_to.name: To date
date_to.description: Only transactions on or before this date.

min_amount.name: Minimum amount
min_amount.description: Only transactions of at least this amount (absolute value).

max_amount.name: Maximum amount
max_amount.description: Only transactions of at most this amount (absolute value).

text.name: Search text
text.description: Only transactions whose counterparty, description or note contains this text.

category.name: Category
category.description: Only transactions in this category. Use "none" for uncategorized ones.

include_pending.name: Include pending
include_pending.description: Also include transactions the bank has not yet booked. These are replaced on every sync, so their id is not stable.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Number of matching transactions to skip, for paging through results.

order.name: Order
order.description: Sort by date, oldest or newest first.

recategorize.name: Recategorize
recategorize.description: Applies the rules in categories.yaml to stored transactions. Never touches transactions categorized by hand.

only_uncategorized.name: Only uncategorized
only_uncategorized.description: If off, also re-applies the rules to transactions that already have a rule-based category (useful after editing categories.yaml).

consent_expiring.description: The access granted to Home Assistant for **{title}** expires on {date}. Re-authorise it from Settings → Devices & services before that date to keep syncing.
